# @lakutata/cache

> 标签: cache, lakutata, memcached, mongodb, mysql, postgresql, redis, sqlite, ttl, typescript

## 简介

The cache component of the lakutata framework (memory, file, Redis, Memcache, MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL stores).

- 官网：https://lakutata.com/packages/cache
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/lakutata/lakutata.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lakutata/cache
